Container.Name: binhex-ariang
Container.Overview: AriaNg is a modern web frontend making aria2 easier to use. AriaNg is written in pure html & javascript, thus it does not need any compilers or runtime environment. You can just put AriaNg in your web server and open it in your browser. AriaNg uses responsive layout, and supports any desktop or mobile devices.
Container.Requires:
**Aria2 RPC authentication** AriaNg has no login of its own, the aria2 JSON-RPC port (6800) is secured with a secret token. ARIA2_RPC_SECRET overrides a secret stored in /config/aria2/secrets/rpc-secret or a secret set in /config/aria2/configs/aria2.conf. If none is set then a secret is generated on start and stored in /config/aria2/secrets/rpc-secret, and the same secret is reused on restart. Open AriaNg, go to Settings -> RPC, set the host to your unRAID IP, the port to 6800 and paste the secret into 'Secret token'.
**Downloads** aria2 saves downloads to /config/aria2/downloads by default. To use the /data mapping, change the 'dir' option in /config/aria2/configs/aria2.conf.

Config.Name: Port: Web Interface
Config.Description: This is the Web UI port for the application.

Config.Name: Port: Aria2 RPC
Config.Description: This is the aria2 JSON-RPC port used by AriaNg to control aria2.

Config.Name: Path: /config
Config.Description: This is the container path to your configuration files, e.g. databases, configuration files, logs etc.

Config.Name: Path: /data
Config.Description: This is the container path to your downloaded files or user created content.

Config.Name: Variable: ARIA2_RPC_SECRET
Config.Description: Secret token for the aria2 JSON-RPC interface, enter it in AriaNg under Settings -> RPC. Overrides a secret stored in /config/aria2/secrets/rpc-secret or set in /config/aria2/configs/aria2.conf. If left empty and no secret is stored, one is generated on start.

Config.Name: Variable: ENABLE_STARTUP_SCRIPTS
Config.Description: Specify whether to run startup scripts to install and/or configure additional applications.

Config.Name: Variable: STARTUP_SCRIPTS_MODE
Config.Description: Specify whether to run the startup scripts sequentially, waiting for each script to complete, or in parallel.

Config.Name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
Config.Description: The command or script to execute, if not specified then the script healthcheck.sh will be used (process, dns and https checking).

Config.Name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_ACTION
Config.Description: The action to execute if the healthcheck command returns a non zero exit code, if not specified the action will be 'exit 1', if you want the container to exit on failure then set the action to 'kill 1'.

Config.Name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_HOSTNAME
Config.Description: The hostname used when performing HTTPS and DNS healthchecking.

Config.Name: Variable: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for the running container

Config.Name: Variable: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for the running container
